sources.entry: ResourceSpace - Simple, fast, and free way to organise your digital assets. (Demo, Source Code) BSD-4-Clause PHP

summary.name: ResourceSpace
summary.one_liner: ResourceSpace is open source digital asset management (DAM) software for organising, controlling, and sharing digital files, aimed at museums, charities, universities, and public sector teams.
use_cases: Sharing brand assets with agencies and media
Central university or research asset library
Tracking asset downloads and usage rights
summary.what_it_does: The page describes ResourceSpace as open source DAM software where source code is publicly available for inspection and extension. It offers structured metadata and search to find assets quickly, plus automated file conversions, approval workflows, and sharing tools. Secure share links, public portals, and a user submission and approval queue are listed for internal and external contributors. It states an open API and pre-built integrations with collections management systems, CMS, and social platforms. Built-in reporting shows downloads by user and frequency, and AI features are described as privacy-focused and not used to train third-party models.
notable: Open source with publicly available source code and no vendor lock-in
Open API and integrations with collections management and CMS systems
Privacy-focused AI features, GDPR compliant by design
Enterprise SSO, MFA, granular permissions, and consent management
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; a free trial is offered after requesting a demo
Tailored setup and support are provided through sales meetings and demos rather than listed self-serve plans
